candidates.title: A document that differs from a held one in letter case alone is linked, and the project reads the other text
candidates.area: Intake: the kit's dedupe (kit.py _store, sci_rag ingester content hash)
candidates.statement: Project rb pastes "... 2000 MG ..." (its own text, mg and upper case) after project ra pasted "... 2000 Mg ..."; rb's outcome says linked and rb's passages read ra's "2000 Mg", a unit nine orders of magnitude from what rb gave.
candidates.contract: docs/api/intake.md:53 "`linked` (the kit held the same text, and the project now holds it too)"; core/openferment_core/models.py:524 "`linked`, the kit held the same text already"
candidates.expected: Text that differs in case (mg against Mg) is other text: ingested as a document of its own, its passages rb's own words.
candidates.observed: rb's outcome: status linked, documentId the same as ra's; rb's overlay passage reads "The biorefinery processes 2000 Mg of dry corn stover per day in the H8 repro." (ra's text). Shown twice: share_probe.py on bh_h8_a and the repro on a fresh database.
candidates.cause: core/.venv/.../sci_rag/ingest/ingester.py:55-58 content_hash_for lower-cases the joined chunk bodies and collapses white space; core/openferment_core/literature/kit.py:588-605 takes skipped_duplicate as the same document and links it (status linked) with no check that the text is the project's own.
candidates.evidence: bughunt/notes/H8/logs/share-probe.log (delta paste of other text: linked c15f02b6...; delta overlay text '2000 Mg'); bughunt/notes/H8/logs/repro-all.log === H8-01 SHOWN.

candidates.title: A project that links a shared document reads the first project's title, licence class and licence words, against its own outcome
candidates.area: Intake and the literature reads (intake.py overlay_papers, kit.documents, search, MCP list_sources)
candidates.statement: When rb pastes text ra already holds, rb's CollectOutcome reports rb's title and licence class open_commercial, while every read rb makes (documents, overlay, search hits, MCP get_document and list_sources) shows ra's title, ra's class restricted, ra's licence words and ra's source name project:ra:paste.
candidates.contract: docs/api/intake.md:36 "The project's link (`documents_link`) keeps the selection: ... `licence` (as the source stated it), `reason` ..."; docs/decisions/ADR-002-sci-rag-kit.md:84 "a shared document is visible to each project that linked it and to no other"
candidates.expected: rb's reads carry the selection rb's link keeps (its licence class, its licence words or none), or the outcome says the document keeps the first collector's title and class; words ra wrote stay out of rb's reads.
candidates.observed: rb's outcome: linked, title "rb's title", licenceClass open_commercial. rb's documents: title "Project ra's own title", licenceClass restricted, source project:ra:paste, selection licence None. rb's overlay: license "ra's words: internal use alone", licenceClass restricted. rb's search hit: licenceClass restricted.
candidates.cause: core/openferment_core/intake.py:151 falls back to document.license_source (ra's words) when rb stated none, and :161 serves document.license_class; api.py:2105-2107 and kit.py search serve the kit's one Document row (title, license_class, source) written at ra's ingest; intake.py:62 builds the outcome from rb's Collected, so it reports rb's title and class.
candidates.evidence: bughunt/notes/H8/logs/share-probe.log, bughunt/notes/H8/logs/mcp-scope.log (delta list_sources: project:gamma:paste, restricted), repro-all.log === H8-02 SHOWN.

candidates.title: An upload whose file name holds %00 answers 500 and leaves a kit document no project holds
candidates.statement: POST /api/intake/upload of report%00.md answers 500 after the kit has committed the document; ra holds nothing, and the next project to upload the same bytes links a document whose source names project ra and whose sourceRef is the server's temporary file path.
candidates.contract: docs/api/intake.md:55-56 "A failure is an answer the Intake board renders: the route raises no 5xx for a document it could not collect."
candidates.expected: HTTP 200 with status failed and the reason in words (or the name kept with its percent sign), and nothing left in the kit that no project links.
candidates.observed: ra's upload: 500 Internal Server Error (log: asyncpg 'invalid byte sequence for encoding "UTF8": 0x00' on UPDATE documents SET source_ref='upload:report\x00.md'); ra holds 0 documents; rb's upload of the same bytes as report.md: linked, source project:ra:upload, sourceRef /tmp/openferment-collected-svfnfnsk/report-.md.md.
candidates.cause: core/openferment_core/literature/collectors.py:1671 unquote(filename) turns %00 into NUL; core/openferment_core/literature/kit.py:596-602 updates source_ref in a second session after ingest_entries committed the document, and intake.py:115-117 catches NotCollected alone, so the database error reaches the route as a 500.
candidates.evidence: intake-alpha.log ([upload] NUL in the name: 500), intake-beta.log (beta linked eb592f... with sourceRef /tmp/openferment-collected-7ajm5d04/nul-byte.md.md), repro-all.log === H8-03 SHOWN.

candidates.title: A JATS XML upload in Latin-1 is kept with its non-ASCII characters replaced: 5 µg/L becomes 5 �g/L
candidates.statement: An XML file declaring encoding ISO-8859-1 is decoded as UTF-8 with replacement, ingested without a word, and its passage reads "5 �g/L of furfural at 30 �C"; the same bytes as Markdown are refused in words.
candidates.contract: docs/api/intake.md:17 "`upload` | a file a person uploads: PDF, Markdown, text, HTML or JATS XML"; core/openferment_core/literature/collectors.py:20-22 "A split returns a `FetchResult` whose status is `failed:fetch` or `failed:parse` with a reason"
candidates.expected: The XML read in the encoding it declares (5 µg/L, 30 °C), or refused in words as the Markdown and text doors refuse a file that is not UTF-8.
candidates.observed: status ingested; kept passage 'The supernatant held 5 \ufffdg/L of furfural at 30 \ufffdC after 48 h in the H8 repro.'; the same bytes as .md: failed, 'the kit did not store it: parse error: 'utf-8' codec can't decode byte 0xb5'.
candidates.cause: core/openferment_core/literature/collectors.py:1688 xml = data.decode("utf-8", errors="replace") before ET.fromstring, so the declared encoding is never read.
candidates.evidence: inline probe on bh_h8_a (passage p0 '5 \ufffdg/L ... 30 \ufffdC'), repro-all.log === H8-04 SHOWN.

candidates.title: import-url answers 500 when the host's redirect carries a malformed Location
candidates.statement: A public host answering 302 with Location 'https:127.0.0.1/x' or 'javascript:alert(1)' makes the route answer 500 Internal Server Error, because httpx.InvalidURL is no httpx.HTTPError.
candidates.contract: docs/api/sff.md:88-96 "Each refusal is said in words a person reads: ... 502 when the host name could not be found, the host refused the connection, could not be reached, or was not read in time, or it answered an error"
candidates.expected: 502 (or 422) in words naming the address and its unreadable redirect; nothing kept.
candidates.observed: /bad-location -> 500 Internal Server Error; /js-location -> 500 Internal Server Error (the app driven through TestClient with httpx.AsyncHTTPTransport replaced by a MockTransport and the resolver by a stand-in mapping public.test to 93.184.216.34; nothing left the machine).
candidates.cause: core/openferment_core/literature/collectors.py:435 client.stream raises httpx.InvalidURL from httpx's _redirect_url (httpx/_client.py:533) while building the redirect; collectors.py:445 catches httpx.HTTPError alone and api.py:1029-1036 catches TooLarge, AddressRefused, NetworkRefused and HostFailed alone.
candidates.evidence: bughunt/notes/H8/logs/fetch-redirects.log ([302 to javascript:alert(1)] -> InvalidURL), import-url-route.log, repro-all.log === H8-05 SHOWN.

candidates.title: A deep search whose graph and HyDE stages fail names no degraded stage
candidates.statement: With no model reachable, profile=deep answers profile 'deep' with degradedStages [] although the log shows query_entity_extraction_failed and hyde_generation_failed (ModelUnavailable); the stage traces read 'empty'.
candidates.contract: docs/api/openapi.json:13180 SearchResponse "the hits, best first, and the retrieval layers that timed out or failed, so a narrow result says why"
candidates.expected: degradedStages names graph and hyde when their model calls fail, so BioRepo Search says 'Not every layer answered'.
candidates.observed: profile deep | degradedStages [] | hits 1; in-process traces: graph empty, hyde empty, with the two ModelUnavailable warnings logged.
candidates.cause: sci_rag/retrieve/stages/hyde.py:37-41 and stages/graph.py:175-179 return nothing on any exception, so the retriever records 'empty'; core/openferment_core/api.py:2132-2134 passes result.degraded_stages through unchecked.
candidates.evidence: inline kit.search probe (degraded: [], graph empty, hyde empty, two warnings), repro-all.log === H8-06 SHOWN.

candidates.title: The report's kit rule counts another document's passage as relevant when the two share a title
candidates.statement: With two documents titled 'Strain report', the question built from document A's candidate retrieves document B's passage first; the kit rule scores it relevant at rank 1 (MRR 1.0) while the passage rule scores rank 2 (MRR 0.5).
candidates.contract: core/openferment_core/literature/report.py:760 and docs/reports/literature-retrieval.md:57 "The kit's rule counts a passage of the question's document, or one holding a quote of its candidates"
candidates.expected: B's passage is neither of A nor holds A's quote, so the kit column counts it irrelevant (first relevant rank 2), or the report says the rule matches by title.
candidates.observed: first passage retrieved is of document 3c02db7e... (B); kit rule first relevant rank 1, passage rule 2; interactive, vector_only and keyword_only alike. In the kept Ethanol run 1 of 252 kit-relevant ranks falls on another document.
candidates.cause: report.py:450 scores with the kit's is_relevant (sci_rag/evals/retrieval_eval.py:52-56), which matches item.title against reference_titles; report.py:364 sets reference_titles to the document's title alone.
candidates.evidence: run file in scratch data/literature/rep-20261110T221405Z.json, repro-all.log === H8-07 SHOWN.

candidates.title: /rag answers its corpus manifest, health, docs and OpenAPI with no key

candidates.contract: docs/decisions/ADR-002-sci-rag-kit.md:106-108 "with none set a key made in memory and never shown stands in, so `/rag` refuses every request"

candidates.title: A catalogue file with an id twice answers it kept twice and the first row is lost without a word
candidates.statement: A CSV with rows S5,First and S5,Second answers kept ['S5','S5'], refused []; the catalogue then holds S5 'Second' alone.
candidates.contract: docs/api/intake.md:104 "Every row that is an entry is kept with the file as its source ... every other row is refused with its reason"
candidates.expected: The second row with an id already in the file refused with its reason (or the answer naming the replacement), and kept listing each id once.
candidates.cause: core/openferment_core/catalogues.py:568-576 appends every valid row; _keep (catalogues.py:466) puts each in turn, the later replacing the earlier.
candidates.evidence: bughunt/notes/H8/logs/catalogue.log (duplicate id in one file), repro-all.log === H8-10 SHOWN.

candidates.evidence: catalogue.log (row naming another keeper and lane: kept with source a row's own words), repro-all.log === H8-11 SHOWN.

candidates.title: An SFF file saved with a UTF-8 byte-order mark is refused as not JSON at line 1, column 1
candidates.statement: A UTF-8 SFF file with a BOM is refused 'is not JSON: its text stops reading as JSON at line 1, column 1', while the catalogue door reads the same BOM (utf-8-sig) and keeps the file.
candidates.contract: docs/api/sff.md:43-44 "A file is refused only when no graph can be read from it: not UTF-8, not JSON, or not an object with a list of units and a list of streams"
candidates.expected: The file is UTF-8 JSON (RFC 8259 lets a parser ignore the mark): read and kept, or refused in words naming the byte-order mark.
candidates.observed: SFF with a UTF-8 BOM: 422 'bom.json is not JSON: its text stops reading as JSON at line 1, column 1'; catalogue CSV with a UTF-8 BOM: 200 kept ['S1'].
candidates.cause: core/openferment_core/engine/sff.py:379 data.decode("utf-8") keeps the BOM and json.loads refuses it; catalogues.py:527 decodes utf-8-sig.
candidates.evidence: sff-import.log (UTF-8 with BOM: 422), repro-all.log === H8-12 SHOWN.
